headline_marked: Clashes erupt in Dhaka: [[Student wings of BNP and Shibir fight]] at multiple sites
headline: Clashes erupt in Dhaka: Student wings of BNP and Shibir fight at multiple sites
summary: Violence broke out at Dhaka College, Jagannath University, and Dhaka Alia Madrasah, with reports of injuries and attacks on patients at National Medical College Hospital.
details: Clashes broke out between activists of the Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal (JCD) and Islami Chhatra Shibir across several locations in Dhaka on Tuesday afternoon.
At Dhaka College, police reported that several people were injured during a fight between the two groups inside the campus. Police arrived at the scene after receiving news of the unrest.
Violence also erupted in front of Dhaka Alia Madrasah in Bakshibazar around 5:15 PM, where activists engaged in chase-and-counter-chase and threw bricks and stones, leaving several injured.
Tensions remained high at Jagannath University, where clashes occurred between JCD, Chhatra Shakti, and JCDSU activists.

The unrest extended to the National Medical College Hospital, where BNP, Jubo Dal, and JCD activists reportedly attacked Shibir and Chhatra Shakti leaders who were receiving treatment in the emergency department.
Witnesses stated that some activists were dragged out of the emergency ward and beaten. Police have been deployed to control the situation in front of the hospital.

headline_marked: 849 children dead: [[Measles death toll rises]] as 2 more die in 24 hours
headline: 849 children dead: Measles death toll rises as 2 more die in 24 hours
summary: According to the DGHS, 1,009 children were newly infected with measles or measles-like symptoms in the last 24 hours.
details: Two more children died within 24 hours due to measles symptoms, according to a regular report from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) on Tuesday.
This brings the total number of deaths since March 15 to 849 across the country.
Of the total fatalities, 753 people died with measles symptoms and 96 were confirmed measles cases.
The DGHS report also noted that 1,009 children were newly infected with measles or measles-like symptoms in the last 24 hours.
